audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagree with their own whys. Rows 1-3 are given to Lucian while the whys say 'it evens out', 'your range edge peaks here' and 'roughly even'; row 4 is 'Skill' while its why opens 'His window'; row 6 is Lucian while its why says 'stays a coinflip'.
audit.why: Karma's Q is 950 range against Piercing Light at 500, so the pre-dash rows belong to her; The Culling plus a 16s Relentless Pursuit is genuinely his 6 window; late reverts to a coinflip where she plays enchanter.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma, Skill, Karma, Skill, Lucian, Skill, Skill in both layers — identical to the packet chart — with ratings re-scaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 why was boilerplate with no numbers for the window it calls dangerous.
audit.why: The Culling is 110/100/90s and Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — his all-in needs both, which is what makes the window trackable rather than constant.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightslinger is described as a double-shot but the page never says Lightslinger attacks REDUCE Relentless Pursuit's cooldown, and never notes the dash goes free at rank 5.
audit.why: Kit text on E: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown', cost 32/24/16/8/0. That is why 'wait out his 16 seconds' is optimistic advice, and it directly changes when a W tether actually roots.
audit.corrected: The shave-down and the zero cost added to the Do's and the interactions row; the double-shot tell added to the Don'ts.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: The Culling is 110s at rank 1 and Relentless Pursuit is 16s — his 6 window opens only when both are up.

edits.before: Lucian whiffs Relentless Pursuit and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s, but every Lightslinger shot shaves it.

edits.before: That is Lucian’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Every ability he casts loads a double-shot, not one auto.

edits.before: Track Lucian’s Relentless Pursuit: His dash — lock him down while it is on cooldown. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and free at rank 5, and Lightslinger shots cut it — the tether only roots while his dash is truly down.

notes: The packet flags 'Relentless Pursuits' in the mid block. It is the real ability name used as a verb ('he just Relentless Pursuits out of the tether'), not a fabricated name, so I left it — flagging in case the style guide wants it reworded. breakdown.mid also calls 4-5 'your bullying peak' while whys[3] calls that stage roughly even; I sided with the whys for the chart and left the prose.
